bibl.title: The False Guardian: An Interpretation of P.Eleph.Wagner 1.
bibl.seg: Demokritos Kaltsas, The False Guardian: An Interpretation of P.Eleph.Wagner 1.

Uri Yiftach & Michele Faraguna (edd.), Legal Documents in Ancient Societies. VI. Ancient Guardianship: Legal Incapacities in the Ancient World. Jerusalem, 3-5.11.2013 = Graeca Tergestina. Storia e civiltà. 4 (Trieste, 2017) pp. 147-163.
bibl.note: Offers a new interpretation of P. Eleph. DAIK 1, 17-19: the case under consideration is possibly that of a marriage contracted without the consent of the bride's proper guardian, her father. The otherwise unknown regulation invoked by the judges in their ruling could be seen as an attempt by the Ptolemies to combat undesirable innovations in marriage customs.
